name: purus
description: Purus - /ˈpuː.rus/ means pure✨ in Latin - is a beautiful, simple, and easy-to-use language. It compiles to JavaScript. It makes your fingers free from the Shift key. With Purus, you can write code almost without pressing the Shift key.

scripts.build: npm run build:compiler && npm run build:ts && npm run build:copy
scripts.format: moon fmt && prettier --write ts scripts test
scripts.format:check: moon fmt --check && prettier --check ts scripts test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run sync && npm run build
scripts.format:check:ts: prettier --check ts scripts test packages .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:ts: prettier --write ts scripts test packages .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts

author: otoneko. (https://github.com/otnc)
